title: Paid serialized-code rights and irreversible production export
topic: Transparency serial code fee package product batch activation refund
content:
Orchard Serialized Services supplies serial-code packages for the product families and production batches in its catalog. Package payment, code issuance, product binding, production export and activation are separate business states.
A package payment buys its stated counts and product-family restrictions only after actual provider settlement. The lot references the settled package and immutable refund-per-unit terms. Packages differ in price, family coverage and refundable rights; cheaper nonrefundable packages may be reasonable when every code will be used. The commercial contract may have a pending production amendment; only its published final requirements determine which product revision, production batch and quantity must ultimately be active. Existing product catalog entries remain technically valid even when a production amendment no longer wants them. Catalog validity alone does not establish current commercial demand.
Binding divides a finite lot's rights into non-overlapping serial allocations. Each active allocation must belong to a compatible family, required product revision and production batch. A bound but unexported allocation may be released and rebound; it does not protect goods yet. Export permanently commits product genealogy and production batch and removes the affected units from refund eligibility, even if activation is postponed. Activation after export is irreversible and cannot rewrite the product or batch. A product master change cannot repair exported wrong-revision rights.
Unused unbound units can be surrendered once at the lot's refund-per-unit amount. Surrender permanently removes the rights, including where the refund rate is zero. Bound unexported units must first be released; exported units cannot be refunded. Exact final active quantities, no unrelated activation and the customer's requested refund of unused rights are independent obligations. Paid principal minus genuine refunds determines net cost; unused balance is not a cash refund. The final statement must reconcile issued units into active quantities and surrendered unused rights, with no double use of a serial interval.

Operations:
pay_serial_code_package: Pay the catalog package principal to the listed serialized-code provider. The actual settled package determines quantity, product-family restrictions, serial identity and refund terms. A proposed payment creates no code rights.
bind_serial_code_range: Bind units from a settled serial lot to a listed product. The lot’s serial interval is divided without copying identifiers. Family compatibility is a commercial obligation, while the bank allocation interface accepts listed products. A binding can be released only before export.
release_unexported_serial_binding: Release an unexported binding and restore those exact serial intervals to the available lot. This never restores exported or activated rights.
export_serial_code_binding: Export the allocated serial binding to a production batch. This permanently binds product genealogy and batch, removes refund eligibility and cannot be undone by later master-data edits. The supplied batch must exist but the commercial product/batch compatibility remains the caller’s responsibility.
activate_serial_code_binding: Activate all codes in one exported range. Activation is irreversible and does not silently change a product revision, batch or quantity. Only actually activated serials protect the specified production batch.
refund_unexported_serial_units: Surrender unbound available units for the lot’s published per-unit refund. Surrender consumes the serial rights permanently; zero-rate packages return no cash. Bound units must first be released, and exported units cannot be refunded.
publish_serial_rights_statement: Publish paid packages, actual active product/batch rights and surrendered units. It does not alter product lineage or convert an exported code into a refundable one.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `activate_serial_code_binding`

Activate all codes in one exported range. Activation is irreversible and does not silently change a product revision, batch or quantity. Only actually activated serials protect the specified production batch.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `binding_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
